attchmntText: Pursuant to the Regulation 30 & 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Board of Directors at their meeting held on today i.e. 14th November, 2026, have, approved the Un-audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 along with Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors  thereon. A Copy of Un-audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated)) along with Limited Review Report thereon are enclosed herewith.
voiceSummary: Modern Threads India Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting occurred on 14th November 2026. Statutory auditors issued a qualified review report. The qualification cites non-provision of Rs. 9.10 lakhs interest on cumulative redeemable preference shares for the quarter and Rs. 18.11 lakhs for the half year. Cumulative unpaid interest stands at Rs. 1101.98 lakhs. Trade payable and receivable balances require confirmation. The subsidiary Modern Woollens UK Limited results were not reviewed by its auditors. Total assets for the subsidiary were Rs. 1733.87 lakhs. Revenue was Rs. 695.16 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 1207.40 lakhs for the half year. Profit after tax was Rs. 42.23 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 88.42 lakhs for the half year. Net cash outflow was Rs. 23.02 lakhs for the half year.
